art_direction: Top-down 3/4 pixel art on a 3D diorama: chunky 1-px outlines, warm torchlight against cool night, medieval European dress; nearest filtering, no mipmaps, sRGB colour maps

groups.files: art/*.png (194 sprite sheets: hero, folk, foes, bosses, animals, farm stock, horses, items)

source.tool: image generation tool, during development (pre-generated, nothing is generated while the game runs)

groups.edits: sliced, scaled to one pixel grid and given real alpha by tools/cut.js; then embedded in index.html as data URIs
groups.licence: owned by the project; declare as pre-generated AI content on any store survey (e.g. Steam Content Survey)
groups.checks: all 194 RGBA with real transparency (no fully opaque sheets); nearest filtering and sRGB set in code

groups.files: textures painted in code (wood, stone, thatch, planks, window panes, halos) in index.html
sfx/*.mp3 and the clips embedded in index.html (SFXDATA)

source.from: OpenGameArt.org, see sfx/CREDITS.txt; trimmed and normalised by tools/sfx.js

groups.files: fonts: Cinzel, Cinzel Decorative, Alegreya (loaded from Google Fonts)
